description: This file contains unit tests for the WebAudio Eos (End of Stream) functionality, specifically testing the behavior of setting EOS on a GstAppSrc element within the WebAudio player context. It uses Google Test framework for defining test cases and mocks for GstWrapper interactions.

classes.name: WebAudioEosTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing WebAudio Eos functionality using Google Test framework.

methods.name: WebAudioEosTest
methods.description: Constructor for the test fixture class, setting up mock objects and context.

methods.name: shouldSetEos
methods.description: Test case verifying that the EOS command successfully triggers the gstAppSrcEndOfStream call and completes without error.

methods.name: shouldFailToSetEos
methods.description: Test case verifying that a failure in gstAppSrcEndOfStream call is handled correctly when setting EOS.
